Subject: Promo codes for HackTrack Build Week — subscriber perks & extended trials

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the quick introduction last week. HackTrack Build Week is Oct 19–23 and we want to give our newsletter subscribers a meaningful incentive to attend the paid sessions — specifically a 45-day Redwood trial and a handful of speaker-level access codes for guests.

High level ask: can Redwood provide a pool of promo codes that we can distribute via our newsletter and event registration flow? Rough numbers: ~4,000 newsletter recipients with expected 12% conversion to claim, and ~75 confirmed speakers/panelists who need elevated access.

We’re flexible on exact allocation and happy to sign a short addendum. Would need:
- 3,000 subscriber-level codes (single-use) with 45-day trial extension
- 75 speaker codes (multi-use, up to 3 activations per code)
- A CSV template to ingest codes into our registration system

Can you confirm feasibility, lead time, and any ops constraints?

Thanks—
Elena Park
Head of Events, HackTrack Inc.
elena@hacktrack.io

Hi Elena — great to hear from you and congrats on the Build Week lineup.

We can do this. Quick confirmations and notes so ops can size the pool:
- Distributor model: we can generate single-use promo codes for 45-day trial extensions for subscribers and create speaker-level codes with the requested multi-activation limit.
- Rate limits & redemption: we’ll need to cap redemptions to prevent abuse; suggested soft cap for subscriber codes = 3,500 (buffer over your expected 3,000).
- Delivery: we can hand off a CSV with codes and metadata (code, type, expiration, activation_limit). Laura will provide the template and a draft addendum.
- Timeline: once the addendum and PO are signed, we can generate and deliver codes within 48 hours.

Can you confirm final counts and whether you want the speaker codes locked to specific emails (we can do email-locked codes) or general elevated codes? Also, any corporate compliance requirements for the trial terms?

I’ll loop Laura and Priyom to propose an internal allocation and the CSV template.

Thanks,

Following up with proposed allocation and the template (attached). This is internal — do not publish the CSV.

Proposal:
- Subscriber pool: generate 3,500 single-use codes, 45-day trial extension, expiration 2027-01-31 for claiming.
- Speaker pool: 100 speaker-level codes, multi-activation limit 3, email-locked optional. Recommend we reserve 25 of these as backups for last-minute replacements.
- Throttling: enable a per-account redemption throttle (1 redemption per 30 days) to reduce accidental reclaims.
- Reporting: we’ll emit a redemption CSV and will keep token-level cost buckets tagged to campaign: HT-BUILDWEEK-2026.

Attachments: 1) promo_codes_template.csv (columns: code,type,activation_limit,locked_email,expires_at,tags) 2) HTW-trial-addendum-draft.pdf (one-page addendum for legal)

Next steps:
1) Mateo to send the addendum + PO request to Elena.
2) Once signed, operations will generate codes (48h).
3) We will drop codes to the HubSpot file or send secure SFTP as preferred by HackTrack.

If we want email-locked speaker codes, we need the list of speaker emails at least 72h before generation.

Laura Bennett
